name: Spinach Strawberry Paneer Salad
ingredients: 100 g low-fat paneer, cubed and pan-toasted
Dressing: 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 2 tsp olive oil, 1 tsp mustard, black pepper
steps: Pan-toast the paneer cubes in a dry non-stick pan for 4 minutes until golden; cool.
Arrange the spinach, strawberries, cucumber and chickpeas in two bowls.
Top with the paneer and drizzle with the dressing.
note: Fruit-sweetened with no added sugar; chickpeas bring extra protein and fibre.
